test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 3% per year rate of interest for 4 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate of Interest (r) = 3% per year

Time (t) = 4 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times r times t}{100}

**Calculation:**

SI = dfrac{2500 times 3 times 4}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{2500 times 12}{100}

⇒ SI = 300

∴ The correct answer is option (3).
